title: Mowgli: AI design tool for mobile, web & desktop apps
excerpt: Generate complete designs for mobile, web and desktop apps. Import Figma files, edit with AI chat, and export to React code or Figma. Free to start.
content_html:
One canvas.
Every screen.

Mowgli holds your whole product in one place: flows, journeys, and designs.

It's spec-driven, so it maintains deep product context.

Here's how it works.

Start from scratch or an existing product

Describe your idea and work through a scoping & understanding questionnaire, or bring in what you already have - drop in a Figma file, or connect your coding agent to push your existing product straight into Mowgli. Either way, Mowgli visualizes your designs and builds a spec in the background.

Importing from your code...via MCP

→ agent connected to Mowgli

reading src/screens…

✓ 24 screens imported

The moodboard

Starting from scratch? Before the full design build, explore 16+ tailored designs for your app. Remix, mix and match, and upload your own references to build custom themes. Ideate, refine, and pick your favourites to preview on the canvas.

See designs for every state and flow

Whether you started from scratch or imported an existing product, Mowgli maps out your whole product (mobile, web, or desktop), gives you ideas, and then creates high-fidelity designs for every screen - not just the happy path.

Iterate at lightning speed

Our chat is built for speed - surgical tweaks, new flows, and redesigns in seconds. The spec is always kept in sync. For teams, Mowgli has built-in real-time collaboration and sharing.

Handoff to AI agents, Figma, and more

Connect your coding agent - Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or any MCP app - and it pulls designs straight into your codebase and keeps them in sync, both ways. Prefer a manual handoff? Push to Figma or download React + Tailwind code. Every export carries a detailed spec and precise styling.

Cursor

Antigravity

Codex

React code

Example projects

Key features

Everything you need to go from idea to production-ready design.

AI Design Generation

Generate complete, high-fidelity UI designs for your whole app or feature idea in seconds and iterate on it with a powerful AI assistant. Mowgli explores your product in depth and designs every possible screen, flow, and state.

Moodboard

Generate an immersive moodboard with 16+ distinct visual styles for your product. Explore colour palettes, typography moods, and design vibes before committing to a direction.

Prototyping

Turn your Mowgli designs into an interactive prototype with real navigation, transitions, and flow. Share a working prototype without writing a single line of code.

Figma Import

Bring your existing Figma designs into Mowgli and use chat to edit, iterate, and evolve them. Tweak layouts, update copy, restyle pages, or rethink whole flows - all with AI. When you're done, export to code for building, or back to Figma for tweaks.

Chat with Your Design

Select any element and say what to change. Mowgli edits your design through conversation - targeted tweaks or sweeping changes, all in plain English.

Export to Code

Connect your coding agent over MCP to pull designs into your codebase and keep them in sync both ways, or export pixel-perfect React components, Figma files, or AI-ready packages.

Style Steering

Steer your AI-generated designs with color palettes and style descriptions. Get themed, consistent designs that match your brand without manual styling.

Responsive Adaptation

Switch between mobile and desktop and Mowgli reimagines your design from the ground up for the target platform.

The new bottleneck? You.

Start building comprehensive products with Mowgli today.

Start your product for free
